messages:
incident-bot: [pager] ALERT: org=vela-org rate_limit spike detected (95th qps 4.2x baseline). Errors rising: 5xx ~ 3% -> escalate

 tim_oncall: Oncall Tim here. I'm pulling graphs in grafana now. @jon_sre can you join? :wave:

 jon_sre: joining. seeing big tail latency on embedding endpoints for vela-org, KV cache miss rate spiking. Suspect sudden burst from streaming pipeline.

 maria_support: Vela customer reported degraded search in prod. Support ticket #6241 open, customer called in. They are high-touch SLA.

 carla_prodeng: If this is causing customer outage, we should consider a focused org-level RL adjustment instead of global changes. Need approval from billing for temporary lift.

 billing_bot: @carla_prodeng billing notice: org=vela-org has enterprise contract. Auto-approval rule requires ops sign-off. Reply 'approve' to confirm.

 tim_oncall: Propose temporary RL increase from 900 qps -> 2800 qps for 30 minutes and enable per-route caps: embeddings=1500, gen=1200. Then monitor.

 jon_sre: Agreed. Also add KV-prefetch for top prefixes and enable fallback model variant light-quantized to reduce load. Rolling these changes now will be staged.

 carla_prodeng: approve

 billing_bot: billing update: approval recorded by carla_prodeng :white_check_mark:

 tim_oncall: Executing mitigation. Commands:
```
# increase org qps
rctl org update --org vela-org --max-qps 2800 --ttl 30m --reason "temp surge - customer outage"
# apply per-route caps
rctl org route update --org vela-org --route embeddings --qps 1500
rctl org route update --org vela-org --route generate --qps 1200
```

 deploy-bot: rollout started for org-config/vela-org-rates @tim_oncall

 jon_sre: Change applied, seeing immediate drop in 5xx to 0.8%. Latency P95 dropping from 850ms -> 320ms. KV miss still high but prefetched keys warming.

 maria_support: Customer reports partial recovery in search. They say results are back but slower than usual. Keeping them updated.

 tim_oncall: Keeping mitigation in place. Setting alert thresholds tighter and creating a canary to auto-revert after metrics stable for 10m.

 carla_prodeng: Please note this will incur extra cost for the org; notify account team to contact customer post-incident.

 billing_bot: Noted. Billing team pinged.

 jon_sre: Monitoring: next check in 5 minutes. If stable for 10m, we'll schedule TTL expiry and revert qps with an automated rollback runbook.

 maria_support: Closing loop with customer, they appreciate quick action. Marking support ticket as in-progress.

 tim_oncall: Handing off to night oncall @alex. I will update runbook and set annotation on incident thread. Incident ticket: INC-2026-904

 alex_oncall: acknowledged. I'll watch the revert window and escalate if metrics regress.

 incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation active. org=vela-org qps=2800 ttl=30m. Next check 1781234780

 jon_sre: Post-mortem to follow, initial notes saved to /wiki/incidents/vela-org-2026-03-10.

 maria_support: :thumbsup: thanks team.
